title: nyc-subwhere source data to drawn train

transformations.name: Worker snapshot pipeline
transformations.prose: Turns the MTA realtime response into the resolved RenderSnapshot served to browsers.

transformations.name: Decode GTFS-realtime
transformations.prose: Decodes each protobuf response into a transit_realtime.FeedMessage.

transformations.name: Build RenderSnapshot
transformations.prose: Combines TripUpdates, VehiclePositions, poll time, and cross-poll memory. It resolves an observed last stop, upcoming arrivals, direction, and stalled status for each renderable trip.

transformations.name: Publish snapshot
transformations.prose: Serializes the RenderSnapshot to KV; GET /api/trips serves that JSON without decoding the feed on the read path.

transformations.name: Browser train pipeline
transformations.prose: Folds each snapshot into a continuous estimate, samples a pose on every animation frame, and updates the Three.js train instances.

transformations.name: TripEstimator.ingest
transformations.prose: Resolves each trip against its baked Track and rebases the new estimate onto the position already shown so changed arrival predictions do not snap a train backward.

transformations.name: TripEstimator.poses
transformations.prose: Samples the current distance along every live Track from animation time and the estimator basis, bounded by the unreached-station hold point.

transformations.name: pointAt
transformations.prose: Walks the Track polyline to the sampled distance, interpolates longitude and latitude on the bracketing segment, and derives bearing from that segment.

transformations.name: NetworkLayer.setTrains
transformations.prose: Converts longitude and latitude to local map coordinates, offsets the train onto its track, rotates it by bearing, and writes the Three.js instance matrix and color.

transformations.name: Draw train frame
transformations.prose: The renderer draws the positioned and rotated train instance in the map's current camera projection.
